children: The predict.fun market put GENG’s probability of winning the League of Legends S16 World Championship at 66%, the highest, while BLG was listed at 20% and ranked first, and T1 at 17%, ranked third. According to Odaily, GENG defeated IG 3-0 in the semifinal to advance to the final, securing one of the two places. BLG and T1 are scheduled to play their semifinal at 6:00 on November 9, with the winner set to face GENG.

title: GENG's League of Legends S16 Title Odds Reach 66% After Sweeping IG
